excerpt.zh: 虚境在波动；它的帷幕变得轻薄。我们将从冥想中退出来。我们窥得的所有见解都会对你公开。
excerpt.en: The Shroud wavers; its veil grows thin. We will now retire to our meditations. Whatever insights we glean will be made known to you.
